_about: Tulle experiment registry. Read by the Experiments tab in dashboard.py. Edit this file (Claude Code) and push to main; Railway redeploys. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); null start_date = planned. results[].counts = {"control":{"n":..,"conv":..},"treatment":{"n":..,"conv":..}} enables the significance check.

experiments.name: Pricing test phase 2 (raised arm vs baseline; NY/CA/International prices)
experiments.goal: More revenue per day without losing Forever buyers
experiments.primary_metric: revenue/day per arm; new Forever buys vs expected

results.note: 10-24 brief: raised $213/d (was $225) vs baseline $221/d (was $199); Forever buys raised 22 vs 28.4 expected, baseline 19 vs 21.7 expected; 46 post-launch Forever buys; 6 price/arm mismatches

confounds_noted: 10-14 bundle (price raise + 20% offer + bonus views + free assistant)

experiments.name: Remove T&C checkbox on sign-up ('By clicking Sign up, you agree...')
experiments.goal: +10-15% sign-up rate (owner est); co-founder: absorb risk if signups +~10%
experiments.primary_metric: sign-up page view -> account created (Mixpanel); NOT raw signups (daily 75-130 swing)
confounds_noted: same publish: sign-in/up layout fix, tour reset, PDF popup copy, cost tools consolidation, 5-star Trustpilot ask

experiments.name: Softer PDF warning + wall copy, inconspicuous submit-PDF link
experiments.goal: Less negative wall experience while holding payment rate
experiments.primary_metric: wall green-CTA click -> purchase (baseline ~140 clicks -> 19 purchases / 30d); warning 88 -> 11
confounds_noted: same publish as checkbox removal etc.

experiments.name: NPS thank-you Trustpilot ask only for 5-star raters (owner test)
confounds_noted: past-buyer review email 2026-10-24 (148 sends) also drives reviews
risks: review gating - against Trustpilot guidelines and FTC review-solicitation guidance; revert = component prop 'Minimum stars for Trustpilot ask' = 1

experiments.name: Vendor search: Railway (Meilisearch) with Xano ep119 fallback
experiments.primary_metric: client-measured search latency p50/p90 + error/fallback rate (Mixpanel)
